$comment: P0.1 upstream version baseline. Every fact here was verified first-hand on 2026-09-11 from the official GitHub tags/releases API and the npm registry. P0.2+ may only consume these pinned versions.

registryChannelReality.$comment: The tag name is NOT the selection basis. On 2026-09-11 npm `latest` still points at the older rc.1; rc.2 is reachable only through the `next` tag.

rejected.0.1.5-rc.1: superseded by rc.2 (published ~12h earlier); no correctness defect recorded, only recency

cliIsolationContract.$comment: Verified first-hand from apps/cli/src/{args,profile-boot}.ts at the selected commit AND by running the installed 0.1.5-rc.2 CLI. These replace the conceptual names used in the plan (empty learning-space path, isolated DSH home, plugin assembly command, temporary port).
cliIsolationContract.homePrecedence: explicit configured path > $DSH_HOME > ~/.dsh; blank/whitespace $DSH_HOME is ignored

launcherFlags.--profile <name>: boot the profile at $DSH_HOME/profiles/<name>; `web` is a hardcoded alias
launcherFlags.--from-default-profile <name>: one-time init of a custom profile from a shipped template (web|headless|acp|sdk|sdk-minimal); shipped names cannot be used as custom targets
launcherFlags.--patch <path>: repeatable extra overlay applied after the profile layer and the home layer
launcherFlags.--dump-config: print composed profile tree and exit without booting
launcherFlags.--dump-default-config: print bundle layers only (no user layer, no --patch) and exit

pluginAssembly.behavior: forwards the remaining arguments to pnpm inside the profile directory; initialized on first use
pluginAssembly.profileLinker: pnpm, nodeLinker: hoisted, autoInstallPeers: false (written by profile init)

webSurfaceFlags.--port <port>: listen port; `0` lets the OS pick a free port
webSurfaceFlags.--trusted-host <authority...>: repeatable extra authority for the /api browser-trust fence
webSurfaceFlags.--no-open: do not open the default browser

webSurfaceDefaultBind.source: packages/bundle/web-app/cordis.patch.yml row `webserver`: config.host = ctx.webStartup.host ?? '127.0.0.1', config.port = ctx.webStartup.port ?? 3080

runtimeObservedNotes.profileInitOnHelp: `dsh --profile web --help` still initializes the profile directory (package.json, cordis.yml, cordis.patch.yml, pnpm-workspace.yaml) and links profile node_modules; the app reports neither service provides a bind, so no server listens
runtimeObservedNotes.proxyWarningObserved: on this machine the CLI prints a warning that `all_proxy` names a SOCKS proxy and then connects directly

isolationBoundary.verifiedIn: /tmp (mkdtemp-style scratch), DSH_HOME pointed at a scratch directory
isolationBoundary.realHomeUntouched: ~/.dsh mtime unchanged (2026-08-24) across every probe in this task
isolationBoundary.sharedServiceUntouched: no boot of any profile that binds a port; StudyForge 4877, the old DSH checkout, and other worktrees were never started or stopped

dependencyTreePolicy.$comment: The lockfile is the arbiter. Every @deepseek-ai/dsh-* and @deepseek-ai/cordis dependency in dsh/package-lock.json must resolve to 0.1.5-rc.2 / 4.0.2-family; a mixed rc is a defect.
